reapack.name: MPE Editor
reapack.desc: MPE Editor - Per-note MPE expression curve editor for REAPER

version.author: externalmethod0
version.changelog:
MPE Editor 1.1.8 Release
Bug Fixes & Improvements: - Eliminated Zero-Delta +8191 Pitch Spikes on Back-to-Back Notes: Fixed an exporter issue where adjacent notes sharing an MPE member channel emitted duplicate pitch bend events at the exact same tick (delta = 0), which caused REAPER's raw CC Bezier evaluator to spike to +8191 (+48 st) at the note transition. Coincident boundary events are now deduplicated while preserving the new note's outgoing Bezier curve and tension. - Back-to-Back Note Duplication & Boundary Curve Integrity: When two touching notes share a single boundary CC/Pitch Bend event at the transition tick, the importer now assigns that boundary point to both the ending note and the starting note, preventing duplicated/second notes from losing their 0.0 st start point and turning into a flat +2 st shelf. - Automatic Curve Recovery from Metadata: Projects saved by older builds where a duplicated note lost its start-of-note raw CC event now automatically recover their full authored curve and Bezier tensions from persisted take metadata on load. - Fresh 7-Day Trial Reset: Reset the 7-day evaluation timer for v1.1.8 so all ReaPack testers whose trial expired during earlier builds receive a fresh 7-day window upon updating. (Note: Public ReaPack distributes the 7-day Trial build; the unrestricted Full DLL is downloaded directly from your Gumroad library.)
Install note: REAPER only loads extensions at startup. Restart REAPER after installing or updating.

version.author: externalmethod0
version.changelog:
MPE Editor 1.1.7 Release
New & Improved: - Continuous Playback Zoom Synchronization: Live horizontal zoom changes during playback are now immediately mirrored to REAPER's Arrange View without snapping back during continuous scroll. - Leftward Media Item Auto-Extend: Moving notes or dragging note attack leftwards past the item start automatically extends the REAPER media item start position (D_POSITION) and length (D_LENGTH) leftward to accommodate notes while maintaining project timeline synchronization (B_LOOPSRC disabled). - Point Tool Shift+Drag Grid Bypass: Holding Shift when clicking and dragging envelope curve points immediately starts point dragging and bypasses grid snap. - Point Tool Double-Click Point Insertion: Double-clicking anywhere on an expression curve in Point Tool (P) inserts a curve point at that position. Shift + double-click bypasses grid snap.
Install note: REAPER only loads extensions at startup. Restart REAPER after installing or updating.

version.author: externalmethod0
version.changelog:
MPE Editor 1.1.6 Release
New & Improved: - Instant Follow Arrange View Re-sync: Toggling Follow on instantly snaps to Arrange View coordinates without requiring playback or navigation kicks. - Exact Sub-pixel Docked Timeline Parity: Precise screen-coordinate mapping eliminates drift between Arrange View and MPE Editor grid/playhead across any zoom level. - Pitch-Bent Note Auditioning: Clicking notes now previews the exact Pitch Bend curve at the clicked offset along the note length, with automatic pitch reset on release. - REAPER Dark Mode Theme Contrast: Guaranteed high-contrast text rendering on dark gray panels and themes (full compatibility with REAPER 7.81+ native Dark Mode). - Playhead Tear Glitch Fix: Synchronized single-sample cursor reading eliminates 1-2px vertical playhead displacement during continuous scrolling. - Shortcut 'W' for File/Item Start: 'W' reliably moves the edit cursor and view to the start of the active MIDI item/file (matching native REAPER MIDI editor navigation). 'Home' navigates to project start. - Shift + Drag Grid Bypass: 100% reliable snap and key scale bypass when dragging or resizing notes with Shift held. - Linear Item Auto-Extend: Extending media item bounds automatically disables B_LOOPSRC to ensure linear elongation without take looping.
Install note: REAPER only loads extensions at startup. Restart REAPER after installing or updating.

MPE Editor 1.1.5 Release
New & Improved: - Full Screen Timeline Alignment with Arrange View: When docked below Arrange View, timeline measures, notes, and the playhead cursor align in a single continuous vertical line across both windows (matching REAPER's native MIDI Editor docker behavior). - Anti-Jitter Playback Synchronization: Eliminated playback screen shaking and feedback loops by anchoring arrange timeline metrics and stabilizing tempo-derived horizontal zoom. - Docker Sizing Parity: Push view synchronization accurately respects Arrange View client geometry, preventing zoom drift when scrolling from inside the MPE Editor. - Win32 Handle & Docking Hardening: Safe docker parent inspection and cached TCP coordinate tracking during playback.
Install note: REAPER only loads extensions at startup. Restart REAPER after installing or updating.

version.author: externalmethod0
version.changelog:
MPE Editor 1.1.4 Release
New & Improved: - Smooth Wheel Scroll Support: Native support for bobo198504's SmoothWheelScroll extension with butter-smooth exponential animation and anti-jitter feedback decoupling. - Continuous Infinite Zoom-Out: Complete project-wide zoom without take boundary clipping or looped source modulo wrapping. - Deep Zoom Performance Optimization: Adaptive grid Level-of-Detail (LOD) subsampling and viewport frustum culling eliminate micro-stutters when zooming far out. - Dedicated Tool Workflows: Duplicate (Ctrl+D), Mute (Alt+M), and note edits isolated strictly to Note Tool (N), preserving Point Tool (P) curve workflows. - Reliable Ctrl+Drag Note Duplication. - Double-click / Alt+click node reset & item boundary background dimming.
Install note: REAPER only loads extensions at startup. Restart REAPER after installing or updating.

version.author: externalmethod0
version.changelog:
MPE Editor 1.1.3 Release
New & Improved: - Note Audition on Click: Selecting or clicking notes immediately triggers audible MIDI audition through the track's instrument chain with dynamics. - Zoom-Out Note Hitbox Priority: When zoomed out horizontally or vertically, note selection hitboxes cleanly take priority over micro-expression curves and handles. - Visual Muted Note Styling: Muted notes are rendered with dimmed, low-contrast coloring and an explicit [M] badge. - Arrange View Follow Decoupling: Smooth and responsive zoom/pan navigation when Follow Arrange View is active. - Built-in F1 Interactive Help: Press F1 anytime for an instant keyboard shortcut reference and workflow cheatsheet.
Install note: REAPER only loads extensions at startup. Restart REAPER after installing or updating.

version.author: externalmethod0
version.changelog:
MPE Editor 1.1.2 Release
New & Improved: - Normal Mouse Wheel Zoom: Bare mouse wheel scrolls to zoom horizontally without holding Ctrl (Ctrl+Wheel scrolls vertically). Fully configurable via action and API, persists across sessions. - Reset All Expressions: Standalone action "MPE Editor: Reset all expression curves for selected notes" and canvas shortcut Shift+F to simultaneously clear Pitch Bend, Pressure, and Timbre CC74 curves with complete Undo history. - Instant Grid Division & Swing Reaction: Canvas dynamically listens to REAPER's grid settings and instantly redraws grid divisions and swing alignment. - Inline Editor Mode: Compact strip attached directly to arrange view items with auto-zoom and 6 modulation brushes. - Host Theme & Docker Integration: Notes inherit item/track colors; curves adapt to light/dark themes; middle-click dock closing supported. - Real-time playhead sync with arrange view & note audition on click.
Install note: REAPER only loads extensions at startup, so restart REAPER after installing or updating.
